notes:
Manafall 0.1.34 - Windows client

What's new in 0.1.34
- Load Save labels: middle-dot separator no longer shows mojibake on Windows.
- Offline sky: volumetric / weather clouds and night starfield improvements (less empty grey / magenta).
- Cold no longer drains Health while Food is still high (cold vs food authority fix).
- Fire douse / ocean relay: Host Offline NullReferenceException spam cleaned up.
- LOD: disabled LODGroup SetLODs spam silenced.
- Class picker DETAILS layout, tree harvest polish, stamina HUD tweaks.
- Phone/touch UI + mobile performance budget layers kept for Android builds.
- Android player forced to landscape (portrait autorotate off).

Still true from recent patches
- Online -> Host opens server options instead of bouncing to the main menu.
- Harvest, hit markers, and loot feel more reliable on clients.
- Host and clients share the same day/night clock.
- Gradual dusk colors; visible sun, moon, and stars; occasional northern lights.
- Koosh plants are harvestable (F); crystals scatter in the world; building fire reacts to rain.

Patcher
- Keeps a partial download; only installs a full matching client zip.
- Auto-update downloads three parts. Leave ~4 GB free on your Windows drive.
